The hunters

How to win: break their three towers, then their base. There is no time limit.
The lanes: two lanes, top and bottom, each with two towers per team. Every 26 seconds a wave marches down both: two snakes in front, then an archer, a skeleton mage and an eagle rider at the back. Break either inner tower and their base opens. Lose both towers of a lane and the enemy sends double lines there.
The jungle: between the lanes, behind curved stone walls and bushes, sit three small camps on each side.
The river: the King Cobra in his fort at the top gives the last hitter +30% damage and speed; the Giant Crab on the beach at the bottom gives a shield as big as your health. Either one heals your whole team nearby. At 6:00 the Cobra becomes the Skeleton Lord: beat him and he leads your next wave.
Tablet aiming: wheel size deadzone (let go inside the deadzone to auto-aim, drag onto X to cancel)Keys: WASD or arrows to move, aim with the mouse, attack with R / F / left click, skills with Space and Shift, shop with B, chat with Enter.
Host: your browser runs the monsters and the rules, so keep the tab open and in front for the whole match.
